blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the focus, vertex and directrix of the following parabolas also sketch the graph: \(y^{2} = 12x\)
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh parabola kis shakal ka hai. Yahan sirf \(y\) square hai aur doosri taraf \(12x\) positive hai.
Yaani yeh bilkul standard form \(y^{2} = 4ax\) hai, jo daayen taraf khulta hai.
Is ki khoobiyan table mein pehle se maujood hain: vertex \((0, 0)\), focus \((a, 0)\), directrix \(x = -a\).
To humara asal kaam sirf \(a\) nikalna hai, phir sab kuch parh lena hai.
Aakhir mein latus rectum ke ends se sahi chaurai wala sketch banayenge.
Yaad rakhiye: is qisam ke sawal mein sab se zyada ghalti \(a\) aur \(4a\) ko mila dene se hoti hai, is liye pehla qadam dhyan se.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y^{2} = 12x\).
Maloom karna: focus, vertex, directrix; aur graph ka sketch.
Tareeqa: \(y^{2} = 4ax\) se compare karna (vertex \((0, 0)\), focus \((a, 0)\), directrix \(x = -a\)).

\(a\) maloom karein
\[4a = 12\]
\[a = 3\]
Kyun: dono equations tabhi ek jaisi hongi jab \(x\) ke coefficients barabar hon, yaani \(4a = 12\).
Dhyan dein: \(a\) 12 nahi, 3 hai; 12 to \(4a\) hai.

Elements parhein
Vertex \((0, 0)\), focus \((a, 0) = (3, 0)\), directrix \(x = -a\), yaani \(x = -3\).
Kyun: yeh 6.3.3 ke table ke pehle column ki values hain; focus curve ke andar daayen taraf, directrix baayen taraf.

Sketch
Latus rectum \(x = 3\) par: \(y^{2} = 36\), \(y = \pm 6\), yaani points \((3, 6)\) aur \((3, -6)\). \(V(0, 0)\) se shuru kar ke in points se guzarta hua daayen khulta curve banayein, jo \(x\)-axis ke gird symmetric ho.
Kyun: sirf vertex se sketch ki chaurai ka pata nahi chalta; latus rectum ke do bilkul sahi points se curve sahi khulta hai.

Tasdeeq:
\((3, 6)\) ka \(F(3, 0)\) se faasla 6, aur directrix \(x = -3\) se faasla \(3 + 3 = 6\). Barabar, jaisa definition kehti hai. Answer key bhi yahi jawab deti hai.
Sketch banate waqt focus aur directrix dono ko figure par zaroor dikhayein; examiner yahi dekhta hai ke curve focus ki taraf khul raha hai aur directrix se door ja raha hai.
blocks.final_answer: Vertex \((0, 0)\), focus \((3, 0)\), directrix \(x = -3\); parabola daayen taraf khulta hai (sketch dekhiye).

answer_figure.alt: Parabola y squared = 12x opening to the right from V(0, 0), focus F(3, 0), dashed directrix x = -3, latus rectum from (3, 6) to (3, -6).
answer_figure.caption: Sketch of \(y^{2} = 12x\)

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the focus, vertex and directrix of the following parabolas also sketch the graph: \(x^{2} = 8(y - 1)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(x\) square hai, is liye parabola ka axis vertical hai, yaani yeh upar ya neeche khulega.
Doosri taraf \(8(y - 1)\) hai, positive multiple, to yeh upar khulta hai.
Lekin \(y\) ki jagah \(y - 1\) likha hai: matlab vertex origin par nahi, ek unit upar khisak gaya hai.
Plan: \(X = x\), \(Y = y - 1\) rakh kar standard form \(X^{2} = 4aY\) banayenge, wahan se elements parhenge, aur phir wapas \(x, y\) mein le aayenge.
Aasaan alfaaz mein: \(x^{2} = 8y\) wala parabola uthaya aur ek unit upar rakh diya. Is liye sab jawab \(x^{2} = 8y\) ke jawabon se sirf ek unit upar honge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^{2} = 8(y - 1)\).
Maloom karna: focus, vertex, directrix; aur sketch.
Tareeqa: axes shift karna, \(X = x\), \(Y = y - 1\); is se \(X^{2} = 8Y\) banta hai jo \(X^{2} = 4aY\) ki shakal hai.

\(a\) maloom karein
\[4a = 8\]
\[a = 2\]
Kyun: \(X^{2} = 8Y\) ko \(X^{2} = 4aY\) se compare kiya.

\(X, Y\) mein elements
Vertex \(X = 0, Y = 0\); focus \(X = 0, Y = a = 2\); directrix \(Y = -a = -2\).
Kyun: table ka teesra column (upar khulne wala parabola).

Wapas \(x, y\) mein (\(x = X\), \(y = Y + 1\))
Vertex: \((0, 0 + 1) = (0, 1)\).
Focus: \((0, 2 + 1) = (0, 3)\).
Directrix: \(y - 1 = -2\), yaani \(y = -1\).
Kyun: shift ne har point ko bas 1 unit upar khiska diya hai, is liye har \(y\) mein 1 jama hua.
Dhyan dein: directrix ke liye \(Y = -2\) mein \(Y = y - 1\) rakhna hai, seedha \(y = -2\) nahi likhna.

Sketch
Latus rectum \(y = 3\) par: \(x^{2} = 8(3 - 1) = 16\), \(x = \pm 4\): points \((\pm 4, 3)\). \(V(0, 1)\) se upar khulta curve in points se guzaarein, \(y\)-axis ke gird symmetric.
Kyun: latus rectum ki lambai \(4a = 8\) hai, focus ke dono taraf 4, 4 units.

Tasdeeq:
\(V(0, 1)\) bilkul \(F(0, 3)\) aur line \(y = -1\) ke darmiyan hai. Point \((4, 3)\) ka \(F\) se faasla 4 aur \(y = -1\) se bhi 4. Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
Ek aur nazar: agar shift na hota to \(x^{2} = 8y\) ka vertex \((0, 0)\), focus \((0, 2)\) aur directrix \(y = -2\) hota. Har cheez bas ek unit upar chali gayi, aur sketch bhi bilkul wohi hai, sirf upar khiska hua.
blocks.final_answer: Vertex \((0, 1)\), focus \((0, 3)\), directrix \(y = -1\); parabola upar khulta hai (sketch dekhiye).

answer_figure.alt: Parabola x squared = 8(y - 1) opening upwards from V(0, 1), focus F(0, 3), dashed directrix y = -1, latus rectum from (-4, 3) to (4, 3).
answer_figure.caption: Sketch of \(x^{2} = 8(y - 1)\)

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the focus, vertex and directrix of the following parabolas also sketch the graph: \(y^{2} = -8(x - 3)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(y\) square hai, is liye axis horizontal hai: parabola daayen ya baayen khulega.
Doosri taraf \(-8(x - 3)\) hai; minus ka matlab yeh baayen taraf khulta hai.
\(x\) ki jagah \(x - 3\) hai, yaani vertex 3 units daayen khisak gaya hai.
Plan: \(X = x - 3\), \(Y = y\) rakh kar \(Y^{2} = -4aX\) ki shakal, table ka doosra column, phir wapas \(x, y\).
Ek misaal se sochiye: \(y^{2} = -8x\) baayen khulne wala parabola hai jis ka vertex origin par hai; hamare sawal mein usi ko 3 units daayen sarka diya gaya hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y^{2} = -8(x - 3)\).
Maloom karna: focus, vertex, directrix; aur sketch.
Tareeqa: \(X = x - 3\), \(Y = y\) se \(Y^{2} = -8X\) milta hai, jo \(Y^{2} = -4aX\) ki shakal hai.

\(a\) maloom karein
\[4a = 8\]
\[a = 2\]
Kyun: \(Y^{2} = -4aX\) mein minus sign sirf direction batata hai (baayen); \(a\) khud hamesha positive hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a = -2\) likhne se focus ghalat taraf chala jayega.

\(X, Y\) mein elements
Vertex \((0, 0)\); focus \((-a, 0) = (-2, 0)\); directrix \(X = a = 2\).
Kyun: table ka doosra column; baayen khulne wale parabola ka focus baayen aur directrix daayen hoti hai.

Wapas \(x, y\) mein (\(x = X + 3\), \(y = Y\))
Vertex: \((3, 0)\).
Focus: \((-2 + 3, 0) = (1, 0)\).
Directrix: \(x - 3 = 2\), yaani \(x = 5\).
Kyun: shift ne sab kuch 3 units daayen khiska diya hai, is liye har \(x\) mein 3 jama hua.

Sketch
Latus rectum \(x = 1\) par: \(y^{2} = -8(1 - 3) = 16\), \(y = \pm 4\): points \((1, \pm 4)\). \(V(3, 0)\) se baayen khulta curve in se guzaarein.
Kyun: latus rectum ke do sahi points se curve ki chaurai theek aati hai.

Tasdeeq:
\((1, 4)\) ka \(F(1, 0)\) se faasla 4, aur \(x = 5\) se faasla \(5 - 1 = 4\). Barabar. Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
Ek aur nazar: focus \((1, 0)\) vertex \((3, 0)\) ke baayen hai aur directrix \(x = 5\) daayen, dono vertex se 2 units door. Yahi to baayen khulne wale parabola ki pehchaan hai.
blocks.final_answer: Vertex \((3, 0)\), focus \((1, 0)\), directrix \(x = 5\); parabola baayen taraf khulta hai (sketch dekhiye).

answer_figure.alt: Parabola y squared = -8(x - 3) opening to the left from V(3, 0), focus F(1, 0), dashed directrix x = 5, latus rectum from (1, 4) to (1, -4).
answer_figure.caption: Sketch of \(y^{2} = -8(x - 3)\)

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) [the book prints no part (iv)] Find the focus, vertex and directrix of the following parabolas also sketch the graph: \(x^{2} - 4x - 8y + 4 = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh general equation hai jis mein sirf \(x\) square hai: matlab parabola jis ka axis vertical hai.
Pehle isay pehchani hui shakal \((x - h)^{2} = 4a(y - k)\) mein lana hai; is ke liye \(x\) mein complete square karenge, bilkul Example 17 ki tarah.
Phir shift, table, aur wapas \(x, y\).
Ek baat note karein: kitab is hisse ko (v) likhti hai, (iv) chhapa hi nahi; answer key isi ko (iv) ke naam se deti hai. Hum ne kitab wala label (v) rakha hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^{2} - 4x - 8y + 4 = 0\).
Maloom karna: focus, vertex, directrix; aur sketch.
Tareeqa: complete square, axes shift, phir table se parhna.

Complete the square
\[x^{2} - 4x = 8y - 4\]
\[x^{2} - 4x + 4 = 8y\]
\[(x - 2)^{2} = 8y\]
Kyun: \(x\) wale terms baayen rakhe aur dono taraf \(\left(\frac{-4}{2}\right)^{2} = 4\) jama kiya; daayen taraf \(-4 + 4 = 0\) ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: 4 dono taraf jama karna hai, warna equation badal jayegi.
Socho \(x^{2} - 4x\) ek adhoora square hai; \(+4\) us ka gumshuda tukra hai jo use \((x - 2)^{2}\) bana deta hai.

Shift aur \(a\)
\(X = x - 2\), \(Y = y\): \(X^{2} = 8Y\), is liye \(4a = 8\), \(a = 2\); parabola upar khulta hai.
Kyun: \(X^{2} = 4aY\) se compare kiya.

Wapas \(x, y\) mein (\(x = X + 2\), \(y = Y\))
Vertex: \((2, 0)\).
Focus: \(X = 0, Y = 2\), yaani \((2, 2)\).
Directrix: \(Y = -2\), yaani \(y = -2\).
Kyun: \(X, Y\) mein elements \((0, 0)\), \((0, a)\) aur \(Y = -a\) hain; sirf \(x\) mein 2 jama hota hai.

Sketch
Latus rectum \(y = 2\) par: \((x - 2)^{2} = 16\), \(x = 2 \pm 4\): points \((-2, 2)\) aur \((6, 2)\). \(V(2, 0)\) se upar khulta curve in se guzaarein, \(x = 2\) ke gird symmetric.
Kyun: latus rectum ki lambai \(4a = 8\) hai.

Tasdeeq:
\((6, 2)\) ko di gayi equation mein rakhein: \(36 - 24 - 16 + 4 = 0\). \(F(2, 2)\) se faasla 4 aur \(y = -2\) se bhi 4. Answer key yahi jawab (iv) ke label ke saath deti hai: vertex \((2, 0)\), focus \((2, 2)\), directrix \(y = -2\).
Note: yeh wohi parabola hai jo 1(ii) jaisa hai magar vertex \((2, 0)\) par; dono mein \(a = 2\) aur latus rectum 8. Jab do sawalon mein \(a\) same ho to sketch ki shakal bhi same hoti hai, sirf jagah badalti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Vertex \((2, 0)\), focus \((2, 2)\), directrix \(y = -2\); parabola upar khulta hai (sketch dekhiye).

answer_figure.alt: Parabola x squared - 4x - 8y + 4 = 0 opening upwards from V(2, 0), focus F(2, 2), dashed directrix y = -2, latus rectum from (-2, 2) to (6, 2).
answer_figure.caption: Sketch of \(x^{2} - 4x - 8y + 4 = 0\)
